balls.text: wow, excellent stuff this, it was a full-toss outside the off and there's no extravagant movement of either the feet or bat, last second reverse flick for a four through fine third-man
fuller on the off stump and he wants to swing across the line, gets it to mid-wicket for a single
slower, shorter and he swings hard over deep mid-wicket, does not come off the middle and goes straight to Sehwag there, third catch for the former Daredevils captain
full-toss again and that looked quite high too, was looking to hit it over the fielder at long-on but it's gone on the bounce to the fielder
fuller on the off stump and tapped to the off side, cross for a quick one
on a length outside the off stump and dabbed down to long-off for a single
dropped! was looking to pull it away to the leg side and it went straight to Pathan at deep mid-wicket who's spilled it! another poor spell from Yadav comes to an end
yorker length ball on the pads, tapped to mid-wicket for a single
outside edged for a four this time, too many of those full deliveries and this was pushed shorter and gets the edge through to the right of the keeper for a four
full-toss, quite high in fact and high enough to be called a no-ball and that's been hit over the bowler for a four!
six more and this is again off a length, swings his bat away and cracks it square over the leg-side for a six! second of the over
fuller this time and hits it to long-on for a single to bring Wright back on strike
length ball and that's smacked over long-on for a six, for some time the fielder thought he might have a chance but no...
poor ball down the leg side, fine leg is pretty fine this time and he flicks it away squarer to get four more
short of a good length, tries to pull it away, gets an inside edge to the fine-leg boundary
was moving across to outside the off stump and looking to flick it over short fine-leg, got away too far and misses
full-toss outside the off yet again and this is crunched through to deep cover for a single
full-toss outside the off stump and hit it to long-on for a single
that's the yorker he needed to get last ball, is only able to push it down to long-off for a single
up and over for a four, he moved across to the off stump and cracked it over the mid-wicket fielder within the circle, it was an attempted yorker that fell slightly shorter than it should have
fuller outside the off stump and tapped down to long-off for a single
short of length and tapped to the deep cover area for a single
well fielded by Morne, it was a full-toss and was played away rather well to short fine-leg, the fielder dives to his right to field that one and gets it down to one
finally gets one full and on the middle stump, the batsman wants to drill it through the covers, gets some bat on it and goes to long-off for one
full-toss on the off stump and tapped down to long-off for a single
shorter in length and pulled away to fine-leg for a four, the fielder was a tad squarer and easily beats him
short of length and it's tucked to short fine-leg, bit of misfield but restricted it to a single
shorter in length outside the off stump and gets an outside edge for a single to third-man
short of a length and tapped to mid-wicket for a single
top edge that goes for a six over third-man! he was looking to slap it over mid-wicket and it only comes off the edge and eludes the fielder there
another shorter one and pulled away to the deep square-leg area again
poor ball, down the leg side and very short, can only pull it through to backward square-leg for a single
bit of a round arm action, but down the leg side for a wide
not up to the bat, can easily go back and push it to the leg side for one
was going down the track and it was sent shorter, pushes it to the off side for a single
very short in length and he's gone back and pulled it through short mid-wicket, Pathan was diving to his right but never got close
shorter outside the off from round the stumps, pushed down to long-off for a single
another one short in length but there is no pace on it, cut hard but straight to the point fielder on one bounce
slower one on the middle-stump line, pushed back to the right of the bowler
shorter in length and tapped down to long-off for a single

and that's a dolly for Virender, Yuvi's gone! there's no doubt this is a difficult track to play too many shots too early, it was a short of length ball and he was looking to smash it some place, pull or cut I am not sure! it gets some bat on it and it lobs up to the off side for a simple catch
another one that's shorter outside the off but yet again, there's no pace on it, tapped down to long-off for a single
almost, just over the point's head! it was a short of a length delivery outside the off and he manages to cut it over the fielder there for a couple
tapped to the right of the bowler and fielded well to end a good over for Delhi
shorter in length and pulled away to deep square-leg for a single
slows down the pace and the shot's played too early, gets his bottom hand off to defend it
shortens his length and he's hit it back to the bowler, fielded to his right
on the off stump and tapped to the off side
fuller on the off stump and driven to long-off for a single
lobbed up and caught to square-leg, the fielder from mid-wicket had to rush to his right before taking a good catch, Finch's miffed with himself for that shot
fuller on the off stump and smacked to short cover, straight to the fielder
and he goes for the pull again, the ball's too short and he isn't going to ignore it, swings away but a good effort from the deep square-leg fielder restricts them to two
short of length and opens the face of the bat to third-man for a single

shorter outside the off and that's pulled from quite away from him to mid-wicket, it did not look like he wanted that single and the late decision almost costs him, the throw misses the stumps though and he gets his 50!
short of length outside the off stump and tapped to the cover region for a single
not a good ball this, the attempt was to cramp him for room by bowling on a length and close to the middle stump, the ball moves back and easily tucked away to the backward square-leg area for a four
shorter in length and that's bit of deft placement after coming down the track, just tapped to backward square-leg for a couple
shorter in length and wants to cut it, goes for it hard but that's easily missed the outside edge of the bat
shorter in length and outside the off stump, tapped to the short cover area
whoa, was in his arc and while it's not really gone out of the park, it's a good, good shot to earn him a six, a pick-up stroke over backward square-leg
shorter in length but was moving back into the batsman to cramp him there, can get it out to the point fielder only
and now defended back to the bowler
another appeal for an lbw against Yuvraj, he was looking to defend at it, beats the bat, hits the pads and there's a big shout for an lbw, that looked close!
bowled him! he's slowed it down so much that Pandey has brought his bat down way earlier than the ball finally came on, misses the line of the ball and it's sneaked through and rattled the stumps
shorter on his pads and wants to sweep it away, does not get it off the middle and it's hit to short fine
on his pads and tucked away to the leg side for a single
outside edge that's gone on the bounce to the backward point fielder for a single
slower outside the off stump and beats the outside the edge, he was looking to crack it through point but misses
shorter in length outside the off stump, tapped to the off side for a quick single
and that's another four for Finch, it's very full on the off stump and that's taken as a full-toss, gets the gap through extra-cover for a four

and now that's been hit over mid-wicket for another boundary, that was a shorter one this time and hes quickly back and smacking, gets it all the way for a six, which is what the fielder at the boundary, Nadeem says too after the umpire has signalled a four
gets it shorter and tapped to the off side this time
gone all the way, it was a fullish delivery and bit of an angle into the batsman, there is a short arm jab because of the length and it's gone for a six over long-on
that makes a good sound as he was looking to cut it away to deep cover, gives room by going across and the bowler's followed him, still gets a single
the lengths quite short and on the leg stump, easily tucked away to the leg side for a single
on his pads and tapped away to the square-leg for a single
reverse-slogged for a couple of runs to wide long-on! that's a short that Warner's made famous, he takes up the stance of a left-handed batsman and smacks it
and now looks to make room and try and cut it away, beats the outside the edge
shorter in length and spinning away to the off stump, patted it to long-on for a single
gets it off the pads and rolls over to the leg-side for a leg-bye
finally off the middle, finally a six! it was shorter in length from Pathan, probably expecting MP to come down again, pulls it without moving out
looks to open his stance up and smack it over the top, gets an inside edge of the bat back to the bowler
goes down the track and the bowler's shortened the length, pushes it to the short mid-wicket area
shorter in length and slower too, the bat-swing had to be drastically changed to defend it to the off side
width outside the off stump but the pace gets lost some place after the ball pitched, tapped to the off side for a single
pulls back his length yet again and it's on the middle stump line, pushes it to the short cover fielder yet again
shorter in length and tapped to short cover, almost looked like the ball never came on
on his pads and he looks to pull it away, hits the pads and rolls over to the leg side
oww, almost a run-out there, it was a fuller one and tapped it to MJ at mid-off, he comes in and fields and has a shy at non-striker's end, misses, the diving Pandey was gone had it hit
quick and straight and he has defended it back to the bowler

gone, caught at point now, is it? was a fuller one outside the off stump and he was looking to drive at it, gets an outside edge and flies to point where it's taken, Uthappa's not convinced it's gone without bouncing and the third umpire's called to adjudicate on it. That's a surprise, it was far from bouncing anywhere but straight into the fielder's hands
down the leg side and starts with a wide, it was a quick enough delivery but with the radar wrong, fuller too
shorter on the off stump and patted it to mid-on for a quick single
and this one has been blazed away through the extra-cover region for a four! fuller on the off stump and he's creamed it through the area, well done

why would you play such a shot, he's been doing well all this while with the straight bat, he was looking to go across to outside the off and scoop it over fine-leg, hit on the pads and an appeal follows
and again, bit more bounce than what he thought, gets an edge through to point
and now the walkathon-slog, only this time he misses, was going down the track to have a pull at it, misses the top edge
on a length and he gets the outside half of the bat through to the point fielder
lot of bounce at Uthappa who does well to open the face of the bat and guides it to third-man for a single
shorter in length and he's looking to tap it to the leg side but it's risen up more than he expected, gets an edge to square-leg
shorter again and tapped to the off side, straight to the fielder
shorter in length and on the off stump, he's on the back foot defending but it's not bounced up too much and gets a bit of a toe
gets closer to the middle stump and fuller, flicked away to the deep square-leg area for a single
glorious, that's absolutely excellent! it was a length ball alright but he was only look to get on to the front foot and push at it, the push beats the mid-off fielder with some ease
and it's outside the off, on a length, tapped to the short cover region
that's the shot of this short time in the match so far, dragged it short outside the off stump and he has absolutely smashed it, over the wide long-on region for a maximum!
length ball on an off-stump line, he takes a couple of steps out and taps it to mid-on for a single, they waited the ball passed the bowler before completing it
shorter in length again and angling back into the batsman, he swivels around and gets it over to deep square-leg for a single
shorter in length and he jumps back to tip it to the leg side
outside the off stump and on a good length, he fishes his bat out and gets it through the backward point, but a single alone
attempts a bouncer but does not rise up as much as he would have liked, was going for the pull but does not get the bat
back to that fuller length outside the off stump, defended back to the bowler, on his right
and even as I said that, that's a tad shorter on the middle, he goes back and taps it to the leg side and before Morne can come around to field it, they are away
there's this concerted effort from Morne to pitch them up to the bat, again he finds that same length and the batsman pushes it to the mid-on region for a single, the fielder had a shy but misses
that's shuffling on to his pads and easily pushed down to deep square-leg, the fielder at fine-leg needs to run around to stop it and they come back for the third
fuller length from Morne and Uthappa is on his front foot and defended to the off side
and now Finch gets into the act the first ball he faces, it's fuller on the off stump and drives it through wide mid-off for a good boundary to start things off
on a good length and it swings back a little, easily tucked away to square-leg for a single
shortens his length completely, tapped to the leg-side this time
and hit for the first four of the day, it was on a length and Uthappa goes down the track as he would to a spinner, not completely off the middle but beats the mid-on easily
shorter this time and outside the off stump, easily cut away through backward point for a couple of runs, the third-man runs across
fuller on the middle stump, floats up to the bat and bit on in-swing into the batsman, Uthappa pushes forward and to the mid-on
slower one yet again and can only tonk it away to long-on for a single
gone, caught at long-on! slower ball, on a length and pulled it straight to long-on, easily taken, the end is nigh.
a very slow ball, outside the off stump and he was looking to scoop it over fine-leg, could have played the same stroke twice and still not connected, it was that slow
straighter and cracked over the bowler's head for a four this time, more vitally over the umpire's head too!
hits him, ouch, the umpire's been hit this time! it was in the slot for the batsman and he goes straight and hits him on his shoulder I think, Taufel's unruffled though
full-toss and missed, just outside the off stump and he was looking to slog it away
a tad quicker this time, outside the off stump and drilled to the extra-cover fielder
slower ball on the middle stump, is full enough to hit it over the top and through to wide long-on where a sprinting Finch dives to his right and prevents the four
full-toss outside the off stump, he was looking for a yorker and missed it, still can only hit it to deep cover for a single
shorter, slower and the slog goes as far as Pandey at long-on, takes it comfortably to peg back the Daredevils even further
fuller outside the off stump and he gets his bat down in time, crashes it through to third-man for a single
fuller, quicker and that's smacked over to wide long-off area for a couple of runs
hits is straight to long-off for a single

a very slow ball and he was looking to slog it away, inside edged on to the pads before rolling towards the bowler, Pathan wanted the single, Yadav did not before coming through, the bowler has a shy at the striker's end but misses
fuller outside the off stump and driven down to long-off, Pathan refuses the single
short of length and slogs it down to long-on for a single
shortens his length a tad and slower too, gets an inside edge to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump and nip away from the bat, misses and through to the keeper

crunched to deep mid-wicket but a good catch! Morkel had to swing and he did just that off the first ball he faces, it goes in the air and straight to the fielder who dives to his right to grab a good one
full-toss on the leg stump and he can only flick it away to deep square-leg for a single

gone, caught, off the second attempt! he wanted to slog it over mid-wicket, the ball was a slower delivery and the batsman hoicks straight to the fielder at deep mid-wicket who fails to hold on to it off the first attempt but grabs it on the second chance there
a very slow ball from Mathews and can only drive it through the covers for a single
and this time he was looking to shimmy a bit to his right and hoick it over the leg side, gets some bat on it to fine-leg for a single
comes down the track but he pushes it a tad wider and a bit slower too, can only get a little bat on to the leg side
and he looks to pull the shorter one yet again but misses the bat
top-edged for a four! it was a shorter ball and he played the right stroke, the pull, got the right result too, just that the direction wasn't quite right, over the keepers head
opens the face of the bat and sneaks it through to third-man region for a single
was looking to walk across to the off side to play it over the on-side, at the last moment, he opens the face of the bat and gets it through point for a four
full-toss outside the off and he was looking to swing it away but can get it only to long-on for a single
shorter in length from round the stumps, tapped to square-leg for a single
short of length down the leg side and he was looking to pull it away, misses and it's gone for a wide
and now looks to slog it over mid-wicket, misses, ends an excellent spell from Murtuza
appeal for a caught-behind by Uthappa, who quickly withdraws it, was fuller and he was looking to cut it, misses
fuller outside the off stump and driven down to long-off for a single
very full on the leg stump and he wants to sweep it away, but misses, there's bit of an appeal for lbw that's quickly aborted
shorter in length and cut away to the off side for a single
looks to come down the track at the spinner who pushes it quicker and easily hit through the covers for a single
full-toss on the leg stump and angling away from the batsman, cracks it over the bowler but the long-on is straight enough to stop it
shorter one that just does not come on to the bat, gets a top edge through to fine-leg for a single
slower one and down the leg side, he was looking to almost sweep it away but misses, wide called
and that's an interesting stroke, he gave himself room by pushing his bat backwards and then hitting it over point for a four!
shorter in length again but it's a slower one, pushed to point
short of length and was looking to run it to third-man, misses
shorter in length, it was at 136 km/hr and tapped to the off side for a single
fuller and pushed into the covers for a single

on a length and it's tapped to the leg side, they take a single and come back for the second, he is miles outside the crease, and should have been run-out but Uthappa fails to collect the ball and dislodges the stumps without it in his hands

fullish this time and that's cracked through the extra-cover region for a couple, reasonable throw but they end up getting an overthrow there, Uthappa did not collect it and they go for a third, he could have still got them out but Uthappa misses it from a few yards away
quicker this time from Yuvi and patted down to long-on for a single
slows it down considerably and he needs to adjust his stroke, pushes it to the off side for a single
fuller from round the stumps, tapped to long-on for a single
goes across to the off stump and chips it over short fine-leg for a six, was on the length and does it well! the extra ball goes for the maximum!
bouncer that time, he was looking to pull it away but he misses, the umpire though thinks it's gone over his head and that's called a wide
was walking down the track and wanted to go over the top but BK shortens the length and he's left with no option to cut it away, was in the air through to deep cover
shorter in length and he's immediately back and tapping to the off side for a single
short of length and outside the off, enough width to cut it to deep cover for a single
on the middle stump, not too much pace, 119 km/hr, tapped it away to mid-wicket
fuller on the off stump and it's bat and pad together and defended to the off side
outside the off and pushed to the mid-wicket region
bowled from well behind the crease I think, tapped away to the off side
tries to pitch it right up to the bat, is a full-toss outside the off stump and driven to long-off for a single
shorter in length and tapped away to the leg side for a single
shorter in length and width outside the off stump, was looking to cut it, but came on quicker, gets bit of a toe of the bat and it runs down through to fine third-man for a four
shorter in length and easily tucked away to the leg side for a single
short of the length and pulled away to fine-leg for a single
short of length and outside the off stump and tapped to the off side

short of length and bowled! it was outside the off and he was looking to pull it across through mid-wicket, probably not short enough but gets an inside edge on to the stumps, they have lost their fifth here
fuller on the off stump and driven straight to the short cover fielder
outside the off stump and gets an outside edge, flies through backward point for a single
outside the off stump, on a length and he opens the face of the bat and guides it through to third-man for a single
length ball on the off stump and pushes it into the covers this time
just bowling those slower ones, fuller too and outside the off stump, tapped to long-on for a single
slower one yet again, on a length and pushed to the off side
short of length and that's pulled away for a four, no pace on the ball, swivels around to behind square
pitches it right up to the bat and tapped straight to short cover fielder
length ball and nips away from the left-hander, beats the outside edge of the bat
shortens his length this time from round the stumps, pushed into the leg side
on the pads and that's tucked away to fine-leg for a single
over the wicket this time, fuller outside the off stump and tapped down the ground for a single

whoa, that's out lbw! it was a quicker one, he was looking to go back and that's snuck through and hit the pads, Uthappa from behind the stumps knows it's out even before he's been given and starts celebrating, the umpire gives it out, looked plumb too

gone, caught at deep covers! he was looking to play it inside out, probably over wide long-off but he manages to slice it more than he was looking for and it goes straight to deep cover and he's gone!
it's not too short to cut from round the stumps but he flays at it, straight to backward point
fuller on the off stump, whipped away to deep square-leg for a single
on the off stump and flicked away to the leg side for a single
slower one and defended back to the bowler
fuller but quite closer to the bat and it's smacked over the bowler's head, the long-on's tidied it up
up and over and for a four, it was tossed up yet again but Sehwag had the width to crash it over extra-cover for a four
pitches right up to the bat from round the stumps, tapped it down to long-off for a single
on the off stump and good length too, pushed into the covers
was a slightly slower delivery, floated right up to the bat and tapped down the ground for a single
on a good length, middle-stump line and flicked away to fine-leg for a single
a little more bounce than he expected, still adjusts well, goes back and taps it to the off side
short of length outside the off stump, not too much width on it and he still throws his bat at it, gets it through to deep cover for a four
middle stump line and fuller too, tapped to Yuvraj at mid-on who fields well and gets his throw in at the non-strikers end, the batsman was way out but the ball never hit the stumps
shorter in length and tapped to the short cover fielder

whoa, he lasts exactly one extra ball after that missed stumping, it was a widish delivery outside the off, had it left it alone it would have been called so, the batsman wanted to get his bat out there and can only loop it straight to point, gone!
stumping missed, tough one, the batsman yorked himself there, missed the bat and the keeper's missed it too
shortens his length and he pushes it to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump, very wide but inside the line, given wide though
round the stumps and a bit fuller, hit to the leg side for a single
shorter in length and tapped to the leg side for a single, there was a quick throw coming in and could have been close had that hit...replays suggest that was out had it hit
short of length outside the off stump, quicker this time and he wants to pull it away, there's bit of swing away from the bat and that's beaten him
slows it down yet again, on the middle stump and pushed to the off side
closer to the off stump and there's a lot of bounce on that one, it was a slower one too and still rises too much for him, beats the outside edge
and that's been cracked through the covers for a four, short of length and smacked on the up, beats the fielder with some ease
shortens his length but the line remains outside the off stump, keeps a tad low too and the pull shot goes to the mid-wicket fielder
length ball outside the off, swinging a bit away and defended back to the bowler
gets the radar right, on the off stump and bit of movement back into the batsman, defended back to the bowler
length ball, on the middle stump and swinging further down the leg side, easily glances away through to fine-leg for a four
edged and dropped again? it was outside the off and this time its Mathews who's tipped it above the bar, difficult chance
and now it's rushed away to fine-leg for a four, there's been some swing all the way through today but Parnell keeps missing his line, gets it on his pads and that's flicked away to the fence
short of length from WP and that's cracked over deep square-leg for a six! Makes the Free-Hit pay but not the best of lengths he will bowl off a Free-Hit
swinging down the leg side for a wide, but before that he's over-stepped too and that means that's a no-ball, which will be followed by a Free-Hit

gone, caught-behind! short of length and he wants to pull it away, there's an appeal for a caught-behind and it's been given out! Warner's not too happy about it but replays suggest there's some bottom edge on it.
good ball that, on a length and swinging back to the batsman, defended back to the bowler
and now he goes down the track and manages to chip it over mid-off, not quite off the middle of the bat but gets enough on it to get it to the fence
shoulders arms to the one that's outside the off stump and swinging away from the bat
that's right up to the bat yet again, gets an outside edge through to the third-man region for a single
on his pads and tapped back towards the direction of the bowler
edged and dropped! that was a difficult one to Finch at the first slip, low down on his right, almost exactly like how he got out against Punjab, this time it's floored
shorter in length and outside the off, MJ did not know whether it would swing back in or go away and that hesitation beats him, misses the edge through to the keeper
ooh, swing back and probably the first time he gets his line right, swinging back and hitting it on the leg-stump line, misses the bat, hits the pad but swinging down
length ball, pulls it back this time and he taps it to mid-wicket this time
good, good, shot, just caressed from the middle stump and through mid-wicket for a four, it was not hit too hard but times it rather well
gets his line right now, back to bowling the middle stump line and gets an inside edge through to fine-leg for a single
wide outside the off stump and not too much of swing, just a straighter ball but too wide and called one
on the leg stump line again and bit of swing too, tapped to fine-leg for a single
on the leg-stump and that's swung down further for a wide, fumbled by the keeper, and it's gone for five wides
